title: Platform Engineer - Geospatial Infrastructure
description: InfraMap provides managed geospatial infrastructure for enterprises. We are hiring a Platform Engineer to build and operate our Kubernetes-based geospatial platform (PostgreSQL/PostGIS, GeoServer, QGIS Server, custom Python services). Stack: Go, Python, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS/GCP, Prometheus/Grafana. You will work on multi-tenant deployments, automation, and developer experience. Required: 4+ years platform/SRE experience, strong Kubernetes and Go/Python, geospatial stack experience a major plus.

ranking.thinking_trace: Excellent platform/SRE match (K8s, Go, Python, Terraform, multi-cloud), full remote, geospatial infrastructure domain alignment.
